headline: Bond liquidation wrecks small caps. Here's how bad some traders see it getting
detail: Bond market stress and liquidation indicate broader market instability and a flight from risk. While not directly small caps, this sentiment can spill over to growth and tech, especially those on margin.
rec: Watch for broader market weakness, particularly in your tech/chip holdings. Be ready to adjust stops on SMH, QQQ, SPY.

headline: Analysis: Higher Treasury yields deliver a reality check on a hot, inflation-prone economy
detail: Rising Treasury yields make risk-free assets more attractive, drawing capital away from equities, especially growth stocks. This reinforces the negative pressure from higher rates on your tech-heavy portfolio.
rec: This reinforces the need to manage risk in your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU) and potentially reduce overall exposure to high-beta tech.
